textual.observation: The source promotes passive income and links registration to starting to earn through the referenced site.

evidence.quote: Want passive income? Then this is for you.
link to registration, you will also register and start earning on him

textual.context: Promotional/instructional context; the records do not establish whether the earning claim was accurate.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised passive-income outcome is directly linked to the requested registration through the supplied referral destination.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish actual earnings, transaction outcomes, site operation, or whether the registration link worked.

textual.observation: The speaker instructs viewers to purchase hashrate for a stated minimum amount as part of the cloud-mining activity.

evidence.quote: buy a hashrate, select one of the points and buy on the minimum amount $20 worth dollars
you will also register and start earning on him

textual.context: The purchase instruction is presented as part of a promotional explanation of cloud mining.
textual.potential_relevance: A requested payment for hashrate is linked to the stated opportunity to start earning through mining.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the purchased hashrate produced returns, whether the amount was actually charged, or what terms applied.

textual.observation: The speaker identifies one pool as the most profitable and reports prior profit after changing the pool setting.

evidence.quote: the most profitable is this f2 pool
before i had profit of $1.76 today I changed setting

textual.context: The statements are presented as an instructional recommendation about pool selection; no independent comparison is supplied.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed profitability and reported profit are tied to selecting or changing a mining-pool setting.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the measurement period, net versus gross profit, or whether the pool was actually more profitable.

textual.observation: The speaker states that withdrawal commissions increased and connects the change to wallet load and cryptocurrency-rate instability.

evidence.quote: the commission for withdrawals was increased
related to the load and also to cover this unstable rate of cryptocurrency

textual.context: The fee increase is presented as a stated condition affecting withdrawals; the records do not show whether the explanation was independently confirmed.
textual.potential_relevance: A withdrawal-fee condition is linked to the cryptocurrency-mining returns being promoted and could affect the resulting amount available to a participant.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the fee amount, timing, recipient, or effect on any actual withdrawal.

visual.observation: A dashboard banner visibly states in Russian: "ICO стартовал, бонус 25% - только сегодня" and shows Polybius branding.
visual.context: Promotional banner within a cryptocurrency-mining account interface; no warning, quotation, parody, or disclaimer is visible in the sampled frame.
visual.potential_relevance: A time-limited 25% bonus is presented as an incentive tied to ICO participation, creating a conditional reward and urgency cue.
visual.limitations: The sampled frame does not show the required action, payment or transfer terms, eligibility, recipient, or whether the offer was completed; some text is small.

visual.observation: The interface shows a hash-rate selection control and a green "Активировать" button, while nearby SHA-256 and Scrypt panels display income and forecast-return figures in cryptocurrency and currency units.
visual.context: The screens appear to show a cloud-mining product workflow and dashboard rather than a completed transaction.
visual.potential_relevance: A requested activation of mining capacity is displayed alongside projected income or return figures, linking an interface action to a promised or forecast benefit.
visual.limitations: Sparse samples do not establish whether activation required payment, how returns were calculated, or any actual payout, click, redirect, or outcome; detailed amounts and terms are not fully legible.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker advises viewers unfamiliar with cloud mining to read about it and become acquainted with the activity.

evidence.quote: if you have not dealt previously with cloud mining then I advise you you read what it is and, in general, get acquainted with cloud mining

visual_context_notes.observation: The sampled screens show a HashFlare-branded dashboard with BTC and ETH balances and SHA-256 and Scrypt mining sections.
A Russian modal labeled "Реинвестировать" is visible with explanatory text and "Закрыть" and "Сохранить" buttons, indicating a reinvestment feature in the dashboard.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes cloud mining for passive income, provides a registration referral, and directs viewers to purchase hashrate to start earning. It presents prior profit and projected figures alongside a stated withdrawal-fee increase; the available video evidence does not establish actual payouts or losses, and does not establish that the separate ICO bonus was connected to the mining offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: Paid mining returns are the central observed mechanism: the speaker instructs viewers to purchase hashrate, links registration and the purchase to earning, and discusses mining capacity, pools, and reported mining profit.
